text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Singaporean businessmen have identified areas of potential investment in Zimbabwe following a three-day official visit by Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong.

- Zimbabwean President Robert Mugabe left Harare for London on Sunday night for the country's second major investment drive this decade intended to attract further British investment while also expanding markets for Zimbabwean products.
- Operation V4, which seeks to cleanse Zimbabwe, Mozambique, South Africa and Zambia of organised cross-border vehicle thefts, has so far recovered 1,378 cars worth an estimated Z$230 million.

- The government is now recovering Z$6.5 million every month from former university students and says the money can be borrowed by first year students who fail to raise half of their college fees as required by new regulations.
